title: Task requests
description: Post and manage buyer requests for quotes, custom work, or procurement.

help.title: About task requests
help.overview: A task request is a client's job asking providers for quotes: what they need, where, and up to what budget. It takes bids for 30 days; accepting one awards it and opens an order.

sections.title: Each request
items: Title, category, currency and a main image are required; on-site work also needs the address. The budget is optional.
The best-rated providers whose listing is in its category, and for on-site work whose service area covers the address, are told about it.
Open: taking bids. Closed: by the client or after 30 days. Awarded: a bid was accepted, and it can't change any more.
Close request tells everyone with a pending bid. Reopen request starts a new 30 days.
Notify all looks again for matching providers and tells the ones who haven't heard about it yet.
Nobody can bid on their own request. Each row shows how many bids it has.
